rows.requirement: Count families with >=2 eligible distinct RNA sequences with PDB structures
rows.source_and_wording: Research plan 2026-10-08, 'What the professor is asking': "Count how many families have at least two eligible, distinct RNA sequences with PDB structures. A count of PDB entries alone does not answer this question." (plan states it was taken from the meeting transcript; the transcript itself is not on disk)
rows.interpretation: count families, not entries; distinct sequences; eligibility after provenance and construct review
rows.implementation: inventory.py funnel; manual review of all 31 screen-passing families; v4 sequence-only route for non-curated families
rows.remaining_gap: explicit-link discovery only reaches the 74 curated families; 16 non-curated families with sequence-only proposals not reviewed; 1,793 sequence-only proposals mostly unreviewed

rows.requirement: Link each PDB chain/family region to a specific Rfam row; explain organism, origin, coverage
rows.source_and_wording: plan 2026-10-08: "Link each selected PDB RNA chain and family region to a specific Rfam alignment row, and explain its organism, sequence origin and residue coverage."
rows.interpretation: exact row, entity source (not host), exact-source genome check, observed fraction
rows.implementation: structures.py build_link; exact_source_check.py; evidence cards; crosswalk

rows.requirement: Remove repeated structures of the same sequence; review construct meaning, especially motif mutations
rows.source_and_wording: plan 2026-10-08: "Remove repeated structures of the same sequence and review the biological meaning of each selected construct, particularly mutations affecting motifs."
rows.interpretation: group by exact interval sequence; construct review; engineered cases kept separate

rows.requirement: Compare ordinary seed with structure-curated seed for shared sequences; count comparable families
rows.source_and_wording: plan 2026-10-08: "Compare ordinary Rfam seed alignments with the structure-curated seed collection for shared sequences; count the families for which this comparison is possible."
rows.interpretation: residue-correspondence comparison of shared rows, matched release
rows.remaining_gap: identity holds in every release with a curated file; a pre-curation comparison per family is possible only via older ordinary releases (rows absent before 15.0 for RF00522)

rows.requirement: Run original STAR3D on suitable non-identical homologs; investigate motif-region disagreements
rows.source_and_wording: plan 2026-10-08: "Run original STAR3D on suitable, non-identical homologous RNAs from the same family, then investigate motif-region disagreements."
rows.interpretation: original v1.2, defaults; both directions; region review

rows.requirement: If no suitable experimental cases, bring the search to Smriti and ask about predicted structures
rows.source_and_wording: plan 2026-10-08: "If suitable experimental cases cannot be found, bring the documented search to Smriti and ask about available predicted structures or how to generate them."
rows.remaining_gap: decision for the researcher: whether to trigger the fallback

rows.source_type: explicit professor statement as recorded in plan
rows.source_and_wording: plan 2026-10-08: "the professor explicitly allowed metabolite binding as potentially acceptable"
rows.interpretation: ligand state recorded; comparable states favoured

rows.source_and_wording: plan: "Prioritize different organisms because that matches his example"
